g.text: Starting the XGBoost fit from the forecast solar output beats the best guess

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Top: each arm's quantile score (dot) with its 95% interval from re-drawing whole weeks of forecast start and seeds. Grey line: d0, the best guess. Dashed lines: climatology and manual_heuristic, scored on 40 fewer rows. Bottom: planned contrasts with 98.75% intervals. Left dashed line, -0.10: a gain. Right dashed line, +0.10: the margin an arm must stay under to match d0. Grey line, 0: same score. Quantile score in points of capacity (1 point is 1% of a substation's capacity), on daylight half-hours of April to September at five Primary substations.'
